lines: Ministry: Out of memory is not a plot twist. Free something or ask for less.
Ministry: Handle exhausted. Close what you opened, pilot.
Linker: Disk full at link time. The binary would have been magnificent.
LLVM: Allocation folded under pressure. Shrink the request, retry once.
Platform: If this persists, check ulimits, pagefile, and open handles — in that order.
usage: Resource lines are data-only companions for E0009 (and, sparingly, E0006/E0010). The selector appends at most one, deterministically, and only in normal mode.
